why: Git lesson s1. Each git config line was typed without its value (`git config --global user.name` with no name, `git config --global alias.i` with no `init`). With no value git only reads the key; both are unset, so it prints nothing. `git config --list` then shows no user.name and no alias.i. 'user.name' and 'alias.i' are on screen only inside the commands typed: nothing was set.
